info.name: Nightware Talk recordings
info.summary: Shares Talk call recordings and transcripts with their conversation.
info.description: Talk's recording server and transcription put each recording, transcript and summary in the files of whoever recorded the call ({attachment folder}/Recording/{token}/). This app shares each one with the conversation (a read-only room share, as Talk's "Share to chat" makes) as soon as it lands there, so every participant has it. Needs Talk (spreed). Shipped with Nightware's Docker Compose stack (deploy/nextcloud/apps).
info.author: Nightware
